metadata.display_heading: ASSOCIATIVE-EFFECTS, INCLUSIVE FITNESS, AND FISHER'S THEOREM

blocks.content: We conclude by examining some of the important implications for evolution when heritable associative effects ($ \sigma^{2}(A_{s}) > 0 $) are present. First and foremost, their presence has significant implications on the evolution of mean population fitness (Bijma 2010a), which forms the subject of this section.
